title: security_requirements.json
description: Schema for .ai/blueteam/data/security_requirements.json — normative security requirements derived from assessment findings

generated_by_assessments.description: List of assessment report names (without .md extension) that contributed entries

requirements.description: Normative security requirements derived from findings across all assessments

id.description: Sequential identifier: SR-001, SR-002, etc. Never reused or renumbered.

title.description: Noun phrase summarising the control, max 80 chars

priority.description: Priority derived from the highest severity source finding

description.description: Optional human-readable summary (used by overview SPA)

requirement_text.description: Full normative requirement using RFC 2119 keywords (MUST, SHOULD, MAY)

rationale.description: Why this requirement exists; cross-references organizational standards or ASVS

sources.description: References to source findings in assessment reports

related_code_change_ids.description: CC-NNN IDs from code_changes.json that this requirement covers; populated during merge
